reviews.title: How I feel about Fetch
reviews.text: I absolutely 100% LOVE Fetch. Fetch is the only reward program that does what they say they are going to do. Rather scanning a receipt or playing a game, I know I will always receive points and I know I am able to turn those points into whatever I choose. I have had one issue with receiving points from a game and all I had to do was call them and they fixed the issue in minutes. Not only did they fix it and give me my points, they gave me a lot of extra points for my inconvenience. To be honest, I was extremely surprised and impressed with what Fetch offers, how they work, how easy Fetch is and how quick and simple they are. I have tried other point earning apps and not one of them do or offer what Fetch does. If you do not have Fetch and you’re reading reviews to see what other people think, you absolutely need to get Fetch because I can promise you that you will not be disappointed. Last year I saved all my points and waited till the beginning of December, I cashed them in all at once and I was able to give my family an extremely nice Christmas. I was able to get my guys what they wanted from where they wanted it and it didn’t cost me a dime. To be honest, I could go on and on about how amazing Fetch truly is but I won’t. Only because I would be writing this review for hours. But please, don’t take my word for it, give it a try. After all, what could trying it hurt ? Hope everyone is having a fabulous day and that my review helps someone out.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: When the app works the way it’s supposed to it’s awesome. You just snap pics of your receipts and it scans email/amazon/Walmart for your e-receipts and your on your ways to gathering points. You don’t have to select things ahead of time and pan thru alot of scrolling to find deals if you don’t want to. If you want to optimize your rewards you can look and see what’s going to give you points that week and buy accordingly but you don’t have to select it like some apps. What I absolutely hate and I been using this app for a couple years and have dealt with it the whole time is its glitchiness! It’s maddening. It sometimes will not gather my receipts even tho my accounts are linked and they are being scan. For over 6 months it stopped recognizing my email receipts even tho it would scan my email. I got sick of it and stoped using this app all together as 90% of my shopping is e-receipts. Came back months later and it was working again and been using it for a few months now happy again and it started acting up again. This time it’s doing it with all the linked accounts. Sometimes it does recognize and credit me for some however it’s super delayed and will autogenerate them later but only some not all of them. I take all the steps to unlink/link the accounts, update the app and clear cookies and it’s continuously glitchy and frustrating. Esp when I purposely purchased something online to get the pts and it won’t find the receipt! I am in fb groups for fetch customers and this is a ongoing issue with many people.

reviews.title: EASIEST Rewards App Ever!!
reviews.text: I am not one to normally write a review, like EVER, so me actually taking my time to write this one should show you just how amazing I feel this app is!! It is by far the EASIEST rewards app ever! All you have to do is keep your receipts long enough (but not too long—I'll get to that in a second 😉) to take a picture and upload them to earn points. Once you’ve accumulated enough points, you can decide which gift card you’d like to redeem. How simple is that!? The only downfall (if you can really even call it that) that I have found is that the receipt can’t be more than 14 days old. I’ve only had a handful of times where that’s happened to me. BUT that is totally my own fault for not taking the 5-10 seconds to pull up the app and take a picture of my receipt right away and/or waiting longer than 2 weeks to try and upload it. I feel that 2 weeks is a pretty generous timeframe to get your receipts scanned. I will also add that you are only able to scan 35 receipts in a 7-day period. Which again, I can totally understand as most of us really don’t shop at more than 5 stores per day every day. I feel like that limit is to help cut down on the “cheating” aspect by someone using other people’s receipts and uploading like 100 a week per say. Which is only fair for a free rewards app! So it can take quite awhile to build up your points, but I didn’t expect anything less when I signed up for this free app that gives away free gift cards for simply scanning your receipts. It’s so Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy 😁 Thank you, Fetch!!

reviews.title: Edited: not so great anymore.
reviews.text: Shop and get money back. What’s not to love? Update: while I still like the app, it appears that all of the awesome point earning options are fewer and farther between. The offers used to be ‘buy one thing and get a lot of points’. Now it’s buy a ridiculous amount of items from the same brand and and get mediocre points. And the offers are pretty much all the same now. General Mills, Pillsbury, candy and alcohol. There’s only so much cereal and taco shells I can eat. There used to be a daily bonus that you’d spin a wheel to get but that has been replaced with playing games to win points, and the points you earn are not worth the time and effort. Lastly I’ve shopped thru Fetch 4 times at Temu which should have given me a ton of points and only one of the orders is showing up as pending. The other three are gone. I’ve tried contacting them about it and all I get is an answer they cut and paste to everyone explaining what the program is. I know what it is. I also know that it takes 90 days for the points to show up in my account. What I don’t know is where the other three orders are that are supposed to be pending on my account. I’ve sent them a list of the missing orders, dates, amounts etc. 3 times now and each time they want me to give them even more information. Pretty soon they are going to ask me for a kidney before they actually resolve the issue. Here’s an idea…don’t advertise 250 points per dollar spent on Temu if you don’t plan on awarding them. This is all very disappointing because the app used to really be awesome.

reviews.title: Trying My Patience
reviews.text: This app should be simple, but it has some major issues. The scanning program lacks "intelligence" and misinterprets words to the point I think I am reading a lost language. There is no way to verify accuracy BEFORE the scanned receipt is submitted creating the cumbersome task of addressing items "not accepted" days after the submission. There is nothing like saving a bunch of packaging with barcodes for days after the product has been used to be on the safe side of being able to adequately challenge Fetch Rewards "denials". Today, I had a receipt denied because I had reached the maximum of 7 receipts in 14 days without having any reason to know that is FR policy. Where is it written? Why??? Some people shop often because they cannot store a lot at one time. I would think the food manufacturers would love people shopping for their brands several days a week. There is no clear way to know which inventory within a given brand is acceptable before purchase. I have somehow managed to accumulate 3,000+ points pretty fast, but I spent a ridiculous amount of time to earn points equal to $3. I chalked up the low earnings vs time spent to improving my learning curve. Would someone please explain how point distribution is determined. Does it vary by brand, price, item or according to whether or not the planets are in proper alignment. I am trying to be patient because I WANT to like this app.

reviews.title: My bestie for the restie

I understand how fake this sounds, and I still do this day, Will not openly download or use an app that incentivizes me to make money by playing a game. This is the only app that I fall so vulnerable to because it really works. I have gotten a multitude of gift cards and they really do work. They really work. I promise on everything. reviews.title: I don’t know why you wouldn’t use it.
reviews.text: I love your app. I buy both brand name and store brand products. Sometimes I like the feel or smell of a brand better, sometimes I like the value of the the generic brand. I have run across running out of submissions because I have more than 14. It’s a bit worse lately because now you accept fast food and restaurant receipts. I just leave them until the end because they are only 5 points. I do tell people to look over your points because sometimes you don’t get them like you should. Walmart is notorious for giving things odd abbreviations or hard to see receipts. Gatorade always gets points but they call it GZ 32 sometimes. (Gatorade Zero 32ounce). So I just fix it. So be sure you look and get all of your points. Fetch even lets you scan the product if that’s easier for you to show what you really bought. Thank you so much for your APP. It helps my budget go further when I get money back for buying what I was going to buy anyway. Sometimes I do make a choice between 2 items because one gets points. But usually I just do my shopping and scan my receipts. Oh, the best time to scan your receipts is just after you put them in the car and before you leave the parking lot. I put a little notch on one corner so I know I’ve scanned it. That way it’s done but if I need to return something that doesn’t fit, etc, I still have an intact receipt.

reviews.title: Update Fail
reviews.text: I have loved using Fetch Rewards for the last two years. I have been able to get rewards from my normal shopping activity. There are times when I am buying an item like soda and It isn’t brand specific, so I will choose one that offers bonuses (ex. buying Pepsi vs. coke). Getting gift cards on all my purchases has been great. However, the December 2021 app update added a feature that made me want to immediately delete the app forever. I am a private person and don’t share purchases or anything else personal with friends, family, and definitely not with strangers. The Social/Beta feature immediately showed what “friends “ my account was connected with from referrals. I could see all the activity these people had with Fetch. It also showed them everything I did, so that we could “compete”. One of these friends was a person I did not know at all (Wes). Now, my friends may have always been able to see my activity and I didn’t know it, but that is something I will never appreciate. After a long time researching I figured out how to disconnect friends from my account. This fixes future activity, but these people (remember Wes is a person I have never met), can still see previous activity. Also, if you invite others to join Fetch, they will be able to see your private information unless you manually disconnect them. Fetch, please remove this feature. I will not be sharing your app with friends as long as this feature is an automatic feature.

reviews.title: Removing the daily spin was not cool you guys
reviews.text: Before the update I loved this app. Although it’s not much you get back, every penny counts to a college student. They used do have a daily spin for extra points, and I loved that because although most days it was 5-15 points you spun, it was the big amounts of points that kept me coming back and using the app every day. I would save my receipts if I had multiple in a day and make sure to scan one everyday for the points, thus coming back to the app and using it daily, making it a bigger part of my routine. However, they since removed the daily spin for another “play” feature, which uses tracking across your phone. I don’t care if they keep the play feature on, but give me back my daily points or I lose motivation to come back to the app everyday. This app used to be great, and it’s still okay but lost points in my book. 6/10 at best now. Also, whenever you go to claim some points for a receipt, they literally have 10+ ads you need to skip through to get back to the Home Screen. It’s actually crazy. So I updated to add on some critiques, and I love the way they only looked at the old criticism, not the new one. I’ve had the og part about the daily spin up for several years, I just hate the pop up promotions constantly, so when they only look at the first bit of a review and not the second it tells me they’re aren’t fully reading reviews.

reviews.title: Great app overall but…..
reviews.text: One of my favorite receipt scanning apps due to ease of use. I like that I can play games, get boosts on points for certain products, certain retailers, spending a certain dollar amount at select retailers, and getting products at certain retailers. I like that it tells you if the receipt will be approved before it is submitted (must have date, retailer and total spent completely visible, will show green check when ready to submit). Rewards are select retailers and restaurants and visa cash cards. Dollar amount of rewards is based on how many points you have. This is one of the higher point rewarding apps (25 vs 5-10 for other apps) but, as mentioned earlier, point boosts can happen if you plan right. There is a log of what products, retailers and dollar amount spent to check and how many points. Plus, with games, you download (through fetch) and reach levels to get points. The higher the level, the more points but it needs to be done in a certain timeframe. You have to be a new user to earn points with Fetch. You also can’t double up-meaning if you use another receipt app that allows you to earn points the same way with the same game, you can’t earn points off that game through that app. Only thing I can complain about is, with other receipt apps, you can “cash out” points via PayPal. That would be nice.
